Commands.Stdout:
Description:
  Run generative AI models locally, privately, and offline.
  
  Command groups:
    Model:  model, cache
    Run:    run, chat, complete, transcribe
    Server: server
    Setup:  config
    Help:   status, report

Usage:
  foundry [command] [options]

Options:
  -?, -h, --help         Show help and usage information
  --version              Show version information
  -o, --output <format>  Output format (text|json). Defaults to text. [default: Text]

Commands:
  model                      Discover, inspect, download, load, and unload local models
  chat <model>               Start an interactive local chat session
  complete <model> <prompt>  Generate one stateless text completion
  run <model>                Run a model with automatic routing to chat or transcription
  server                     Start, stop, restart, inspect, and troubleshoot the local Foundry daemon
  cache                      Inspect and manage downloaded model cache entries
  config                     View and edit persistent Foundry CLI settings
  status                     Show system, service, model, and connectivity diagnostics
  report                     Open a pre-filled GitHub issue with diagnostics
  transcribe                 Start an interactive local speech transcription session or transcribe a file

Description:
  Start, stop, restart, inspect, and troubleshoot the local Foundry daemon

Usage:
  foundry server [command] [options]

Options:
  -?, -h, --help         Show help and usage information
  -o, --output <format>  Output format (text|json). Defaults to text. [default: Text]

Commands:
  start    Start the Foundry daemon and OpenAI-compatible local service
  stop     Stop the Foundry daemon
  restart  Restart the Foundry daemon and OpenAI-compatible local service
  status   Show daemon state, URLs, PID, uptime, and log location
  logs     Show or follow daemon and SDK log lines

Description:
  Start the Foundry daemon and OpenAI-compatible local service

Usage:
  foundry server start [options]

Options:
  -p, --port <port>         TCP port for the local service. Use 0 for an OS-assigned port; omit to use configuration.
  --idle-timeout <minutes>  Stop after this many inactive minutes. Omit or use 0 to keep the daemon running.
  -?, -h, --help            Show help and usage information
  -o, --output <format>     Output format (text|json). Defaults to text. [default: Text]

Description:
  Show daemon state, URLs, PID, uptime, and log location

Usage:
  foundry server status [options]

Options:
  -?, -h, --help         Show help and usage information
  -o, --output <format>  Output format (text|json). Defaults to text. [default: Text]

Description:
  Inspect and manage downloaded model cache entries

Usage:
  foundry cache [command] [options]

Options:
  -?, -h, --help         Show help and usage information
  -o, --output <format>  Output format (text|json). Defaults to text. [default: Text]

Commands:
  list, ls                   List cached models and variants
  location                   Show the active model cache directory
  cd <path>                  Set the model cache directory
  clear, remove, rm <model>  Remove one cached model, or all cached models when no model is supplied

Description:
  List cached models and variants

Usage:
  foundry cache list [options]

Options:
  --device <kind>        Filter by device kind (cpu|gpu|npu).
  --type <task>          Filter by model task (chat|speech|embedding).
  --search <query>       Substring match against alias, display name, model id, variant, or execution provider.
  --limit <n>            Limit the number of rows in the output (must be > 0).
  -v, --verbose          Include local cache paths.
  --variants             Show one row per cached device-optimized variant.
  -?, -h, --help         Show help and usage information
  -o, --output <format>  Output format (text|json). Defaults to text. [default: Text]

Description:
  Show the active model cache directory

Usage:
  foundry cache location [options]

Options:
  -?, -h, --help         Show help and usage information
  -o, --output <format>  Output format (text|json). Defaults to text. [default: Text]

Description:
  View and edit persistent Foundry CLI settings

Usage:
  foundry config [command] [options]

Options:
  -?, -h, --help         Show help and usage information
  -o, --output <format>  Output format (text|json). Defaults to text. [default: Text]

Commands:
  show               Show all configuration values and their sources
  set <key> <value>  Persist a configuration value
  reset <key>        Reset one configuration key, or all keys

Description:
  Persist a configuration value

Usage:
  foundry config set <key> <value> [options]

Arguments:
  <key>    Configuration key (port|cache-directory|idle-timeout-minutes|log-level).
  <value>  Value to persist.

Options:
  -f, --force            Apply daemon-affecting changes without an interactive restart confirmation.
  -?, -h, --help         Show help and usage information
  -o, --output <format>  Output format (text|json). Defaults to text. [default: Text]
